name: Grade 3 English Term 1 Exam
subject: English
instructions: Answer ALL questions. Read each question carefully.

sections.heading: Section B: Written Questions (46 marks)
items: 1. Read and write: 'The farmer has a big brown cow.' (3 marks)
2. Write the plural of: box, child, man (3 marks)
3. Use 'and' to join: I like rice. I like beans. (2 marks)
4. Fill in: The sun ____ (shine/shines) brightly in the morning. (2 marks)
5. Write two sentences about your school. (4 marks)
6. Arrange the words to make a sentence: plays / Tom / football (2 marks)
7. Write the opposite of: big, hot, day (3 marks)
